name: Phone Story
source:
“Phone Story” is a game in which you can realize your Netorare / Netorase fantasies. The main character goes on a long business trip and leaves his wife Lisa alone. Fortunately, there is a good friend next to her who can support and push Lisa in the right direction. The player is free to choose this direction and the fate of the relationship. Will it be an "open relationship" or will the player be interested in watching his wife slowly become corrupt. Or maybe he will try to keep her interest and loveability? Everything is in your hands.

[From F95Zone]
